relationships.subject: PEG-PLGA nanoparticles
relationships.evidence_quote: combinations of terpene-loaded NPs produced significantly higher calcium responses when compared to combinations of free terpenes

key_findings: Terpene-loaded PEG-PLGA NPs (250-350 nm) increased fluorescence/calcium responses in TRPV1-expressing HEK293 cells compared with free terpenes.
